title: sketch-orca progress line
description: One line of the file `sketch-orca run --progress <file>` appends to: one JSON object per line (newline-delimited JSON). A reader skips blank lines and takes a missing message as "".

stage.description: The step the engine is at: job, presets, model, orient, arrange, slice, gcode, 3mf, stats, then done (ok) or failed. Readers accept stages they do not know.
